# Fixture brief

For teams making product films, show that rendered review reveals mistakes before export so they adopt a review step. Six seconds, landscape and portrait, silent. Claims must be sourced and release stamps must match the package. Important copy should stay within a portrait inset of 10% at the top and 20% at the bottom. Cuts should land on the declared 120 BPM grid, with no offset. This is an intentionally defective test film, not product marketing.
